pairwise_distant_seqs.note: pairwise_distant_seqs d paths: every two unequal sequence values of the supplied list have the closed d.-1 set_ball around the support of one disjoint from the support of the other; duplicates ignored, no path or uniqueness requirement; d = 0 and d = 1 coincide (pairwise_distant_seqs01).

has_k_distant_set_paths.note: has_k_distant_set_paths d k X Y: a supplied list of exactly k entries, uniq, each a seq_set_path X Y, pairwise_distant_seqs d; k = 0 by the empty list, k = 1 iff some X-Y path exists.
